note: The English credit card listing has three product tiles in div.single-card. The second link in each tile is Learn more (the first is Apply now, and for OCBC Credit Card that first link is the C20 application form, which must not be fetched). The OCBC Credit Card tile leads to one shared product page that offers three network options stated on that page and on the SEM campaign page: OCBC World Mastercard, VISA Platinum Card, and UnionPay Platinum Card. Hand in those three as separate cards with flag shared_product_page. The Premier VOYAGE Card and Premier Credit Card tiles lead to /premier-banking/our-solutions/cards/ product pages.
